description: Cancel a meeting the user organizes: every attendee is sent a cancellation straight away, with the optional comment, and the event moves to the Deleted Items folder. It cannot be undone; the meeting would have to be created again. Prefer this over delete_event for meetings with attendees, so they get the message. Only the organizer can cancel; an attendee should use respond_to_event to decline.

comment.description: Cancellation message sent to attendees (e.g. "Cancelling — rescheduling to next week")

name: cancel_event
